ev.q: Veterans had a higher overall prevalence of reported arthritis than nonveterans, 25.6% (CI = 25.2%–26.1%) versus 23.6%
one in four veterans reported that they had arthritis (25.6%)
Of the estimated 9.0 million veterans with arthritis, 8.3 million were men and 670,000 were women.
State-specific, age-standardized arthritis prevalence among veterans ranged from 18.8% in Hawaii to 32.7% in West Virginia.
For both men and women, arthritis prevalence was higher among veterans than nonveterans
Among male veterans (compared with male nonveterans) arthritis prevalence was higher for all age groups
BRFSS is an annual, cross-sectional, random-digit–dialed telephone (landline and cell phone) survey

methods_quotes.q: Variance was estimated with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) that accounted for the clustered design using the Taylor series linearization method.
The 2000 U.S. Projected Population, in three age groups (18–44, 45–64, and ≥65 years) was used for age-standardization.
Data were analyzed using software that accounted for the complex sampling design, including application of sampling weights
Estimates not presented if number of respondents was <50 or relative standard error was ≥30 because estimate might be unreliable.
